title: Women's Cat – Oops. Anyway. Embroidered Zip Hoodie

seo.title: Cat Zip Up Hoodie – Oops. Anyway.
seo.description: A cat zip up hoodie: OOPS. ANYWAY. on the back over a tabby and a tipping mug, plus an embroidered paw pushing a mug off a ledge on the chest.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This cat zip up hoodie is for the woman whose cat pushes the mug off the table, looks right at her and does it anyway, zipped on for the kitchen and the walk to the bookshop.

A grey tabby with closed eyes rests one paw on a round wooden stool while a patchwork mug tips over with a splash of coffee, in grey, mustard, terracotta and teal with a worn print texture. OOPS. runs above it and ANYWAY. below in heavy slab capitals, the second line wider than the first: orange and cream on Black and Navy, rust and navy on Ash. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small cat paw pushing a mug off a ledge is embroidered on the left chest, and the word OOPS is stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest paw and mug and left-cuff OOPS, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Oops. Anyway. zip hoodie fit?
The Oops. Anyway. cat zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this cat hoodie warm enough for chilly mornings?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cool kitchens, morning walks and evenings on the couch well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, OOPS. above the tabby, the stool and the tipping mug, and ANYWAY. below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small embroidered paw pushing a mug off a ledge sits on the left chest with no words, and OOPS is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The paw on the chest and the OOPS cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a cat lover, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the cat owner who has stopped asking why the mug is on the floor. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
